errors.text: It assigns nucleation to free surfaces, whereas the target bulk periodic model identifies vacancy clusters or disordered atoms as nucleation sites.
It reverses the orientation result: the target reports the maximum yield stress along <-111>, not <110>.

It introduces twinning, Lomer-Cottrell-lock-mediated evolution, and a martensitic HCP transformation despite the target reporting partial-dislocation slip and local stacking-fault-induced HCP signatures with no twinning or bulk phase transformation.
It conflates the quaternary FeNiCrMn alloy with the quinary CoCrFeMnNi Cantor alloy and ambiguously substitutes a nanowire/free-surface geometry for the bulk periodic single crystal.
The cited evidence concerns CoNiCrFeMn and Ag nanowires, including surface-driven nucleation and transformations, so it does not support claims about the target bulk FeNiCrMn simulation.
